extracts.lead_summary: Marky's long fired Tuesday and was gone by Friday. XLY closed over $114.68 on Tuesday, sat on the 200-day Wednesday at $115.53, then gave back $2.43 in two sessions to finish +0.57% at $113.10, eight cents under the 50-day. Tesla carried the week: +4.9%, nearly all of it before its Q3 print (EPS $0.48 vs $0.45). The autos did not: GM -9.6% on a guide that would not rise, Ford -6.7%. Amazon gave up 4.6% on Thursday with no sourced cause. The 10Y closed a Friday under 5% for the first time since Sep 18, and Freddie's 30-year finally moved, to 7.32%.
